snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSON LIVE - YOU ARE NOT ALONE BET 15th ANNIVERSARY SHOW  1995
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson performed "You Are Not Alone" at the BET 15th Anniversary Special with the following details:

* Date: September 22, 1995 (some sources list September 23, 1995, likely due to the broadcast schedule)

* Event: BET (Black Entertainment Television) 15th Anniversary Special
* Location: Washington, D.C.

* Era: This performance took place during the promotional cycle for his album HIStory: Past, Present and Future, Book I, shortly after the single "You Are Not Alone" was released and became the first song in the history of the Billboard Hot 100 to debut at number one.
